summary: Tested per-section permissions (backend set-sections contract + UI). All 7 requested features PASS: restricted user (sections=['liquidaciones']) sees only 'Liquidaciones' in sidebar, is redirected from /hoy,/propiedades,/alquileres,/equipo,/contabilidad to /veraos/liquidaciones, Liquidaciones screen loads with no page errors. Default (sections=null) non-admin sees only Alquileres+Studio (liquidaciones redirected to /alquileres). Admin sees all 15 items incl. Equipo. Equipo screen shows 'Acceso: ...' text, 'Secciones' toggle opens 14 checkboxes (equipo excluded), check/uncheck calls backend and persists after reload. set-sections returns 403 for non-admin actor, accepts list/[]/null. Login via data-testid selectors works fine in automation (no stale screenshot issue). Found 1 backend bug (500 on GET /team after set-sections null for unknown email) and 1 frontend edge case (sections=[] -> blank screen).

critical.issue: For an email not in app_access, update_one({_id}, {$unset}, upsert=True) creates a doc with ONLY _id (no 'email'). Then GET /api/auth/team crashes with 500 (KeyError doc['email'] in _row) -> Equipo screen breaks for admin. Reproduced and cleaned up (deleted ghost doc test_ghost@vera.test). Fix: use upsert=False for the $unset branch (or $set email too), and make _row use doc.get('email', doc['_id']).

minor.issue: Setting a list silently sets approved:True (re-approves a revoked user). Section ids are not validated against known ids.

Pre-existing: admin check trusts client-supplied actorEmail (no JWT verification) - anyone can pass the admin email and change permissions. Section restriction is UI-only; backend APIs (e.g. properties, contabilidad) are not restricted per section.

ui_bugs.issue: Non-admin with sections=[] (possible by unchecking all boxes in Equipo) gets a completely blank dark screen (EMPLOYEE_PATHS empty -> navigate('/login') while session exists). Should show a friendly 'Sin secciones asignadas' message or block unchecking the last section.

issues: No UI way to restore the default (sections=null) once a member was customized
'Acceso: ...' text is small and low-contrast grey

action_items: Fix set-sections null upsert creating email-less doc -> 500 on GET /auth/team (upsert=False in $unset branch; defensive _row)
Handle sections=[] in AppLayout (empty-state message instead of blank screen) or prevent unchecking last section in TeamScreen
Optional: add 'Restablecer por defecto' button in Equipo panel (sections=null)
critical_code_review_comments: routes_auth._row: doc['email'] KeyError risk for any doc missing email
Permissions enforced only in frontend; backend data endpoints remain accessible to restricted users
TeamScreen fetch calls lack error handling (no toast on non-200)

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows pass; 1 edge case bug
